# From the Jātaka-ābharaṇa

## The Auspicious Combination (Shrestha Yoga)

> If the benefic planets <note>planets like Jupiter, Venus, or a strong Moon</note> are situated in the 6th, 7th, and 8th houses from the Ascendant <note>the Rising Sign or 'Lagna'</note>, and are neither joined with nor aspected by malefic planets <note>planets like Saturn or Mars</note>, then the person becomes a minister, a judge, or a ruler of the earth. Such a person possesses many wives, enjoys a long life, remains free from disease and fear, and is endowed with beauty and happiness. The Lords of the Yavanas <note>original: "Yavaneshwarai"; likely referring to ancient Greek or Indo-Greek astrologers whose techniques were integrated into Indian astrology</note> state that such a man is of excellent character and remains perpetually joyful. || 5 ||

If the benefic planets are in the 6th, 7th, and 8th houses from the Ascendant and are not influenced by malefic planets, the person becomes a king, a judge, or a minister, having many wives, a long life, health, beauty, happiness, a good nature, and a cheerful disposition. || 5 ||

---

## Now, the Determination of the Qualities and Colors of the Sun and Other Planets.

> The physical form of the body is also described here according to the consensus of the Sages. || 6 ||

Moving forward, the qualities, colors, and physical statures of the Sun and other planets are described according to the opinions of the ancient Sages. || 6 ||

---

## The Nature of the Sun

> The Sun is brave, profound, clever, and handsome. His complexion is a dark-reddish hue, and he has sparse hair. His body is well-proportioned and firm, with eyes the color of honey or tawny-yellow. He is of the Pitta <note>the 'fire' or 'bile' constitution in Ayurvedic medicine</note> temperament, possesses strong bones, and is not tall in stature. || 7 ||

The Sun—brave, serious, clever, beautiful, dark-red in color, with little hair, a square-shaped body, honey-colored eyes, a Pitta nature, strength in the bones, and a short height. || 7 ||

---

## The Nature of the Moon

> The Moon possesses eloquent speech, a pure intellect, and a beautiful body. He has an abundance of blood, curly black hair, and a temperament of Kapha <note>water/earth</note> and Vata <note>air</note>. His eyes are like the petals of a lotus; he is fortunate and of an extremely fair complexion. || 8 ||

The Moon—a pleasant speaker, of clear intelligence, beautiful body, rich in blood, with curly black hair, a phlegmatic and windy nature, eyes like lotus petals, charming, and very fair-skinned. || 8 ||

---

## The Nature of Mars

> Mars is firm in essence, of a reddish-fair complexion, and very generous. He is fierce, brave, of a Pitta <note>bilious</note> nature, and characterized by Tamas <note>the quality of darkness, passion, or inertia</note>.

### On the Purpose of the Planets' Forms

> The physical form of the individual is similar to the lord of the <term>Navamsha: a one-ninth division of a zodiac sign</term> of the Ascendant, or whichever planet is strongest. The complexion should be determined by the lord of the Navamsha in which the Moon is situated. However, one must also consider the family, caste, and country of birth. || 14 ||

The shape and size of the person should be described as being like the lord of the ninth-part (Navamsha) of the Ascendant. The complexion of the person born (<term>Jataka: the subject of the horoscope</term>) should be stated according to the lord of the Navamsha in which the Moon resides. But if there is a discrepancy, one must speak according to the family, caste, and country. For example, if everyone in a particular family, caste, or country is naturally dark-skinned, then even if Jupiter (who represents a fair complexion) is the lord of the Ascendant's Navamsha, one should still predict a dark complexion. || 14 ||

### On the Knowledge of the Three Qualities (Gunas)

> The Moon, Sun, and Jupiter are of the Quality of Purity (<term>Sattva</term>); Saturn and Mars are of the Quality of Darkness/Inertia (<term>Tamas</term>); and Mercury and Venus are of the Quality of Passion/Activity (<term>Rajas</term>). One must surely state the quality of the person based on the planet in whose <term>Trishansha: a one-thirtieth division or degree-based portion</term> the Sun is located. || 15 ||

The Moon, Sun, and Jupiter are characterized by *Sattva* (goodness/purity). Mars and Saturn are characterized by *Tamas* (ignorance/lethargy). Mercury and Venus are characterized by *Rajas* (passion/attachment). One should determine the inherent quality of the individual based on which planet's degree-division the Sun occupies. || 15 ||

> In the third division are the bladder, genitals, anus, testicles, thighs, knees, and feet. These are assigned to the houses starting from the Ascendant in the first and second six-house groups, representing the left and right sides of the body respectively. || 17 ||

### Knowledge of Moles and Marks on the Limbs—

Benefic planets produce a fish-shaped mark, a mole, or a sign according to their strength; malefic planets produce a wound or scar. If these planets are in their own <term>Navāṃśa</term> <note>a one-ninth division of a zodiac sign</note> or their own <term>Dreṣkāṇa</term> <note>a one-third division of a zodiac sign</note> in a fixed sign, and are associated with or aspected by benefic planets or the Moon, then a mark is present. || 18 ||

One should construct a chart according to the <term>Dreṣkāṇa</term> <note>the 10-degree divisional chart used here to map body parts</note> at the time of birth. In whichever limb a benefic planet is situated, there will be a mole, a freckle, or a birthmark. Similarly, in whichever limb a malefic planet is situated, there will be a wound or scar. If a malefic planet is in its own <term>Navāṃśa</term> or <term>Dreṣkāṇa</term> within a fixed sign and is joined or aspected by a benefic planet, then instead of a wound, one should predict only a mark in that location. || 18 ||

### Regarding the Causes of Wounds—

A wound from the Sun is caused by wood or four-footed animals; from the Moon, by horned animals or water-dwellers; from Mars, by poison, fire, or weapons; from Mercury, by earth; and from Saturn, by wind or stones. || 19 ||

If the aforementioned cause of a wound is the Sun, it is due to a blow from wood or a quadruped; if it is the Moon, from a horned animal or an aquatic creature; if it is Mars, from poison, fire, or a weapon; if it is Mercury, from a strike by earth <note>such as a landslide or falling clod</note>; and if it is Saturn, the wound is caused by wind-related ailments or a strike from a stone. || 19 ||

### Determination of Wounds—

A malefic planet in the sixth house <note>the house of enemies and illness</note> causes a wound; if it is joined or aspected by benefics, it causes a birthmark or mole. Where three planets are situated together with Mercury, a wound will surely occur on the limb corresponding to that zodiac sign. || 20 ||

If a malefic planet sits in the sixth house from the Ascendant, it creates a wound. If that malefic in the sixth house is joined or aspected by a benefic, it creates a birthmark or a mole. On whichever limb <note>represented by the sign</note> three malefic planets sit joined with Mercury, a wound must certainly be predicted there. || 20 ||

If the Moon is in Aries, Saturn in Aquarius, the Sun in Sagittarius, and Venus in Capricorn, the man never enjoys his father's wealth but becomes eminent through the strength of his own arms. || 21 ||

At the time of birth, for one who has the Moon in the sign of Aries, Saturn in Aquarius, the Sun in Dhanu <note>Sagittarius</note>...

<header>In the Jatakabharana—</header>

In the house known as the "House of Children" <note>the Fifth House</note>, those learned in the science of horoscopy <term>Horagama-jna: experts in the traditional Vedic system of time and astrology</term> must carefully consider the following matters. || 1 ||

From the Fifth House, one should contemplate a person's intellect, management abilities, sons, counsel, education, humility, pregnancy, and moral policy. || 1 ||

If the Lord of the Ascendant <term>Lagnesha: the planet ruling the first house of the birth chart</term> is located in the first, second, or third house, the first child will be a son. If this Lord is situated in the fourth house, the first child will be a daughter followed by a son. This is how one should first determine the sequence. || 2 ||

The wise astrologer should observe the house named "Children" <note>the Fifth House</note> to see if it is joined with or aspected by <term>drishti: the "glance" or influence one planet casts upon another house</term> benefic planets. If so, one should predict the birth of children; if the opposite is true <note>influenced by malefic planets</note>, then the opposite result <note>lack of children</note> occurs. || 3 ||

If the House of Children is aspected by its own Lord and joined with the sight of benefic planets, it ensures the attainment of offspring for men. However, if it is not aspected by its own Lord and is instead seen by malefic planets, the result is exactly the opposite. || 4 ||

If Venus, Mars, and the Moon <note>original: "Bhrigu, Bhauma, Chandra"</note> are situated in dual signs <term>Dvisvabhava Rashi: Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces</term>, they certainly produce children early on. However, if these same three planets are in the latter half of Sagittarius, they do not produce children; if they are in the first half of Sagittarius, children are born. So it has been stated by the great sages. || 5 ||

In the House of Children, however many planets cast their sight upon it, that is the number of offspring there will be. Those influenced by "male-designated" planets will be sons, and those by "female-designated" planets will be daughters. || 6 ||

<header>Examination of the Fifth House</header>

# Examination of the Fifth House

One should predict the number of children based on the number of planets casting an aspect <note>In Vedic astrology, 'aspect' or 'drishti' refers to the influence a planet exerts on another house from its position.</note> upon the Fifth House. Among those, male children should be predicted from the aspect of male planets, and female children from the aspect of female planets. || 6 ||

Some teachers hold the opinion that the number of children should be told according to the number of the sign present in the house of progeny. If an auspicious planet, situated in its exalted or friendly sign, aspects the Fifth House, it is auspicious for children. # Analysis of the House of Enemies

> If the Fifth House contains the division of Saturn and is aspected by Mercury, the Sun, or Mars; or if the division of Mercury is in the Fifth House and is aspected by Saturn, then a <term>Kshetraj Putra</term><note>A son born to one's wife by another man, often discussed in ancient legal and astrological texts regarding lineage.</note> is born. || 16 ||

If the division of Saturn is in the fifth house and is aspected by Mercury, the Sun, or Mars, or if the division of Mercury is in the fifth house and is aspected by Saturn, then the person will have a "field-born" son (a son produced in his own wife by another man) ||

> As many <term>Navamshas</term><note>A one-ninth division of a zodiac sign used for fine-tuned predictions.</note> as are present in the fifth house and are aspected by malefic planets, so many pregnancies will surely be lost, provided there is no aspect from benefic planets.

Whatever the <term>Navamsha</term> is in the fifth house, as many malefic planets as cast their gaze upon it without the gaze of auspicious planets, that many children will be lost || 17 ||

> If the Son of Earth <note>Mars</note> occupies the house of children, he destroys each child as they are born. If he is aspected by the Son of the Crested One <note>Ketu</note> and the Son of Bhrigu <note>Venus</note>, the first-born is lost. || 18 ||

If Mars is seated in the fifth house, then children are lost after being born. If Ketu and Venus also aspect that Mars, then the first-born child is destroyed || 18 ||

->Now begins the analysis of the House of Enemies and what should be considered therein:<-

Enemies, harsh actions, disease, worry, apprehension, and the auspicious or inauspicious results regarding the <term>Matula</term> (maternal uncle) should be considered from the sixth house || 1 ||

> The aspect or conjunction of malefic planets in the house of enemies results in the destruction of enemies. From the aspect of auspicious planets here, there arises the emergence of enemies and the possibility of disease. || 2 ||

If the sixth house is joined or aspected by a malefic planet, then disease and enemies are destroyed. If it is joined or aspected by a benefic planet, then fear from both enemies and disease should be predicted || 2 ||

# Analysis of the Ninth House

The experts in the science of time <note>horoscopy or astrology</note> have described various types of results arising from the eighth house. All of those results, whether found in the chapters on misfortune <note>original: "arishta"</note> or the chapters on death <note>original: "niryana"</note>, will certainly be explained by us with great care. || 3 ||

Those who know the scriptures of predictive astrology have stated many results from the eighth house; we shall discuss all of these later in the sections regarding misfortune and the departure from life. || 3 ||

->Now follows the analysis of the House of Fortune and what should be considered therein:<-

The inclination toward religious deeds, the arising of good fortune, a pure character, pilgrimages to holy places, and an affection for the ancient chronicles <note>the Puranas</note>—all of these are said to be seen from the Abode of Merit <note>the ninth house</note>. || 1 ||

One should analyze religious activities, the dawn of fortune, a beautiful temperament, and travels to holy shrines from the ninth house. || 1 ||

Astrologers should set aside all other considerations and focus their efforts solely on the House of Fortune here. For longevity, mother, father, and lineage all become blessed only when accompanied by good fortune. || 2 ||

Those who know the science of astrology should leave aside all other houses and consider only the ninth house. This is because life span, mother, father, and family lineage are all made successful only through one's destiny. || 2 ||

The ninth house from the Ascendant <note>original: "murti," referring to the first house or body</note> and from the Moon is celebrated as the Abode of Fortune. If that house is occupied or aspected <note>viewed by a planetary influence</note> by its own lord, it brings about the rise of fortune in one's own country. If it is influenced by others <note>benefic planets</note>, it brings success in other regions. If the lords of these houses are in their signs of exaltation, they always grant fortune; however, if they are weak, they lead to the attainment of great sorrow. || 3 ||

The ninth place from the birth ascendant and the Moon is called the House of Fortune. If the ninth house is joined with or aspected by its own master, fortune rises in one's own land. If it is joined with or aspected by auspicious planets, fortune rises in foreign lands. If the lord of the ninth house is in an exalted position, fortune rises everywhere. If the lord of fortune and the auspicious planets are powerless, then instead of fortune, one only gains suffering. || 3 ||

# Inquiry into the Tenth House

> If the son of the Sun <note>Saturn</note> is situated in the middle of the sky <note>the 10th house</note> from the Ascendant or the Moon at birth, he creates a livelihood of a very low nature and constant emaciation in the body. There is distress, fear of disputes, a lack of grain and wealth, and a restless disposition due to high mental agitation, with a character that is not pure. || 10 ||

If <term>Saturn</term> <note>Shani</note> is in the <term>Tenth House</term> <note>the house of profession and public life</note> from the <term>Ascendant</term> <note>Lagna</note> or the <term>Moon</term>, the person earns a living through lowly means in the service of others. They possess a weak physique, experience mental unrest due to the fear of arguments, lack wealth, and have a fickle, wicked nature caused by emotional turmoil. || 10 ||

> One should determine the acquisition of wealth from the Sun and other planets moving in the sky, situated in the tenth from the Ascendant or the Moon, during their respective planetary periods: from the father, mother, enemy, friend, brother, wife, and servant respectively. || 11 ||

If the <term>Sun</term> or other planets are seated in the <term>Tenth House</term> from the <term>Ascendant</term> or the <term>Moon</term>, then during the <term>Planetary Period</term> <note>Dasha</note> of those specific planets, wealth is gained through the father, mother, enemy, friend, brother, <term>wife</term>, and servant, respectively. || 11 ||

->**He describes the livelihood according to the Lord of the Ninth Division of the Tenth House—**<-

> One should determine the livelihood by the lord of the ninth division <note>Navamsha</note> occupied by the planet in the tenth house from the Sun, Moon, or Ascendant. The Sun <note>the Jewel of the Day</note> provides a means of living through medicines, wool, grass, and gold. || 12 ||

Whichever is the strongest among the <term>Sun</term>, the <term>Moon</term>, and the <term>Ascendant</term>, one should predict the livelihood based on the nature of the lord of the <term>Ninth Division</term> <note>Navamsha; a 3°20' subdivision of a sign</note> of the <term>Tenth House</term> relative to that strongest point. For example, if it is the Sun's division, profit comes from trading in medicines, wool, grass <note>or forest products</note>, and gold. || 12 ||

> The Lord of the Stars <note>the Moon</note> here indicates livelihood from women, water-born products, or agriculture. Mars indicates fire, courageous deeds, metals, or weapons. The Son of the Moon <note>Mercury</note> indicates various poetic arts. || 13 ||

If the <term>Ninth Division</term> of the <term>Tenth House</term> belongs to the <term>Moon</term>, the livelihood should be said to come from women, products originating in water, or farming. If it is the division of <term>Mars</term>, the livelihood comes from fire, acts of bravery, metals, or weaponry. If it is the division of <term>Mercury</term>, the livelihood comes from the poetic arts and various skills. || 13 ||

If the Sun is in its own sign, its exaltation, or its trine, one should predict wealth gained through the strength of one's own physical effort. || 16 ||

If strong, auspicious planets are placed in the Ascendant, the Second, or the Eleventh houses, there is great happiness and wealth. This was stated by the greatest of the ancient sages; it should be contemplated according to the estimated strength of the planets. || 17 ||

If powerful, benefic planets are in the <term>Lagna</term> <note>The Ascendant or First House</note>, the Second House, or the Eleventh House, then land, wealth, and happiness are obtained. # An Analysis of the Eleventh House

## An Analysis of the Eleventh House <note>original: "Lābha-bhāva-vicāraḥ"</note>

One should analyze the Eleventh House <note>The Eleventh House in a birth chart is known as the 'House of Gains' (Labha Bhava).</note> to determine the acquisition of elephants, horses, gold, clothing, gems, palanquins, beautiful ornaments, and all other types of goods. || 1 ||

If the Eleventh House is occupied or aspected by the Sun, or if the Sun’s divisional strength <note>original: "Shadvarga," referring to the six-fold division of a sign used to calculate planetary strength.</note> is present there, wealth is acquired in many ways through the king <note>In a modern context, this refers to the government or state authorities.</note>, from groups of thieves, through disputes, or from four-legged animals. || 2 ||

If the Eleventh House is occupied or aspected by the Sun, or if the Sun’s divisional strength is present in the Eleventh House, one should predict the gain of wealth through the king, thieves, quarrels, or animals. || 2 ||

If the Eleventh House is occupied or aspected by the Moon, or if the Moon’s divisional strength is present there, there is an increase in wealth related to water-reservoirs, women, elephants, and horses if the Moon is full. If the Moon is waning or weak, the opposite results should be understood. || 3 ||

If the Eleventh House is occupied or aspected by the Full Moon, or if the Moon’s divisional strength is present there, there is an increase in water-reservoirs, women, elephants, and horses. If the Moon is weak in strength, one should understand the results to be the opposite. || 3 ||

If the Eleventh House is occupied or aspected by Mars, there is the acquisition of excellent ornaments, gems, and gold. There will be journeys to various places, great courage, and skill in various arts through the application of a fine intellect. || 4 ||

If the Eleventh House is occupied or aspected by Mars, there is the gain of excellent ornaments, jewels, and gold; travel to many locations, great daring, proficiency in various arts, and a beautiful intellect. || 4 ||

If the Eleventh House contains the divisional strength of Mercury <note>original: "Saumya," a name for Mercury meaning 'the gentle or lunar one.'</note> and is occupied or aspected by Mercury, happiness is obtained through various types of poetry, arts, and writing. Furthermore, there is the cleverness to earn money, an increase in wealth through noble courage and industry, friendship with merchants, and honor through eunuchs <note>original: "Kliba," historically referring to the third gender or palace officials.</note>. || 5 ||

If the Eleventh House contains the divisions of Mercury and is occupied or aspected by Mercury, one finds happiness through various forms of poetry, craftsmanship, and writing. Additionally, there is the strategy for earning money, the accumulation of wealth through noble courage and effort, friendship with the merchant class, and honor is said to come to men through eunuchs. || 5 ||

The man will be a follower of sacrificial rituals and holy people, and will receive excellent favor by being dependent on the king.

> If the Eleventh House contains the division of Jupiter and is associated with or aspected by Jupiter, the person possesses abundant gold. ||6||

If the division <note>varga: a divisional chart used in Vedic astrology to determine specific strengths</note> of Jupiter is in the eleventh house <note>labha-bhava: the house of gains and income</note> and is joined or aspected by Jupiter, then the individual performs sacrificial rituals, serves holy men, receives the favor of kings, and possesses wealth such as gold and other riches. || 6 ||

> If the Eleventh House reaches the division of Venus, or is joined or aspected by Venus, there is great gain of fine silver and pearls through women or through travels. ||7||

If the division of Venus is in the eleventh house and is joined or aspected by Venus, then through women <note>original: "veshya," referring here to entertainers or courtesans</note> or through foreign travel, there is a gain of abundant wealth such as silver, gold, and pearls. || 7 ||

> If the Eleventh House is aspected or joined by Saturn and contains his division, for men there is gain of sapphires, iron, buffaloes, and elephants, along with honor from groups of villages and towns. ||8||

If the division of Saturn is in the eleventh house and is joined or aspected by Saturn, then the person gains sapphires <note>original: "neela," also referring to blue cloth or indigo</note>, iron, buffaloes, and elephants, and receives respect within their villages. || 8 ||

> If the Eleventh and Fourth Houses are situated in the divisions of benefic planets and are joined or aspected by them, men receive many kinds of gains, or likewise if aspected by all planets. ||9||

If the divisions of benefic <note>auspicious</note> planets are in the eleventh and fourth houses, then even if joined or aspected by any planet, various types of gains occur. || 9 ||

### Considerations of the House of Expenditure; what should be contemplated there:

> Loss, charity, expenditure, punishment, and even confinement—all this must be carefully considered from the House of Expenditure. ||1||

Loss, charity, expenses, fines, and imprisonment—all these should be diligently examined from the twelfth house <note>vyaya-bhava: the house of loss and liberation</note>. || 1 ||

> If the waning Moon or the Sun, or both, are situated in the House of Expenditure, or if the House of Expenditure is aspected or joined by Mars, the King shall take away his wealth. ||2||

If the waning Moon, the Sun, or both are placed in the twelfth house, and if it is aspected by Mars, then the King <note>the government or state authority</note> seizes that man's wealth. || 2 ||

# Consideration of the House of Expenditure

> If the full Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus are situated in the twelfth house, they create a foundation for the accumulation of wealth. However, if Saturn is placed in the final house <note>the 12th house of expenditure</note> and is joined or aspected by Mars, there will be a destruction of wealth. || 3 ||

If the full Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus are in the house of expenditure <term>Vyaya Bhava: the 12th house in a birth chart, usually associated with loss but here indicating savings when occupied by benefics</term>, then the treasury remains full of wealth. If Saturn sits in the house of expenditure and is joined with or aspected by Mars, wealth is destroyed. || 3 ||

## The Chapter on Misfortunes is described as it relates to the results of the Houses—

> If the seventh and fifth houses from the Ascendant or the Moon are joined or aspected by their own lords and by benefic planets, then the attainment of a wife and sons is certain. If the son of the Earth <note>Mars</note> is in the fifth house, it causes the loss of sons. || 1 ||

If the Sun is in the Ascendant and Saturn is in the seventh, the wife dies. If Mars is in the fifth house, there is a loss of children. || 1 ||

> If Venus is situated between malefic planets, and the fourth or eighth houses are joined by cruel planets, and Venus is not aspected by benefics, then the destruction of the wife occurs by hanging or by fire. || 2 ||

If Venus is positioned in the fourth or eighth house while being "hemmed in" between two malefic planets, and no auspicious planet casts its gaze upon it, then the man's wife will die by the noose <note>hanging/strangulation</note> or by fire. || 2 ||

> If the Sun and Moon are in the twelfth and sixth houses, the husband and wife will both be one-eyed. If Venus and the Sun are in the seventh, ninth, or fifth houses, the man will be bereft of a wife. || 3 ||

If the Sun and Moon are in the sixth and twelfth houses, both the husband and wife will be <term>Ekaksha: one-eyed or having impaired vision</term>. If Venus and the Sun are in the seventh, ninth, or fifth houses, the man remains without a wife <note>either through loss or inability to marry</note>. || 3 ||

> If Venus is in the seventh house at the junction of two zodiac signs, and the son of the Sun <note>Saturn</note> is in the Ascendant, then the man becomes the husband of a barren woman, provided the house of children is not aspected by or joined with benefics. || 4 ||

# Analysis of the House of Loss

> Take the age, the number of the birth sign, and the number of the birth star; add them together and place the sum in three separate places.

If the remainder is zero in the first or third spot, there is distress. If the remainder is zero in the second spot, there is loss of wealth. If the remainder is zero in all three spots, death occurs. If there are remainders left in all three spots, the person will be victorious in that year. || 16-17 ||

# Results of the Sun's Position

Example—Suppose a person was born in the year <term>Samvat</term> 1988 <note>The Samvat or Vikram Samvat is a Hindu calendar era starting in 57 BCE</note>, under the <term>Chitra Nakshatra</term> <note>The 14th lunar mansion</note> and the sign of Sagittarius.
We wish to see the results for the year <term>Samvat</term> 2003.
Therefore, the Year Number = 15 <note>2003 minus 1988</note>,
Birth Nakshatra Number = 14,
Birth Rashi (Zodiac) Number = 9,
The sum of all these = 38. Place this sum in three places, multiply by 2, 4, and 3 respectively, and divide by 7, 8, and 6—

# Now, the Chapter on the Results of the Sun and Other Planets in the Houses.
## First, the results of the Sun situated in the Ascendant (Lagna)—

-> "If the Sun is in the Ascendant, the person has little hair, a lazy body, is angry, fiercely arrogant, lustful, suffers from eye disease, has a rough body, is brave, patient, yet merciless. If in Cancer, the eyes are prominent; in Aries, it destroys status; in Leo, the man is night-blind; and if situated in Libra, he is stricken by poverty and loses his sons." <note>original Sanskrit: "Lagne'rkalpakachah..."</note> <-

He in whose birth chart the Sun is in the Ascendant <term>Lagna</term> will have little hair, be lazy, angry, of a very fierce nature, lustful, afflicted with eye disease, have a dry or rough body, be brave, forgiving, and merciless.

If the Sun is situated in the <term>Ascendant (Lagna)</term> <note>The first house of the zodiac, representing the self and physical body</note> and is in the sign of Cancer, the person will have a cataract or film over the eyes; if in Aries, they will have a restless temperament; if in Leo, they will suffer from night blindness; and if in Libra, they will be impoverished and childless. ॥ 1 ॥

## Results of the Sun in the Second House—

The man in whose <term>House of Wealth</term> <note>The second house, governing finances and speech</note> the Sun is situated becomes devoid of riches, children, and excellent vehicles; his intellect is ruined, and he resides in the houses of others. ॥ 2 ॥

In the Hindi commentary: He whose Sun is in the second house is lacking in wealth, sons, and transport; he is foolish, harbors malice toward virtuous people, and lives in the homes of others. ॥ 2 ॥

## Results of the Sun in the Third House—

He will be sweet-spoken, endowed with wealth and vehicles, inclined toward good deeds, and accompanied by servants. Such a man will have few younger siblings and will be very powerful when the Lord of the Day <note>The Sun</note> is positioned in the <term>House of Siblings</term> <note>The third house, also representing courage and brothers</note>. ॥ 3 ॥

In the Hindi commentary: He whose Sun is in the third house is pleasant in speech, possesses wealth and vehicles, keeps his mind on righteous actions, has servants, has few younger brothers, and is strong. ॥ 3 ॥

## Results of the Sun in the Fourth House—

The <margin>Lover of the Lotus</margin> <note>A poetic epithet for the Sun, as lotuses bloom when the sun rises</note> makes a man devoid of happiness, vehicles, and wealth; he causes the father's residence to be unstable and the man to be a wanderer.

In the Hindi commentary: He whose Sun is in the fourth house is lacking in happiness, vehicles, and wealth; he destroys his father's wealth and resides in many different places. ॥ 4 ॥

---

The Sun residing in the <term>House of Children</term> <note>The fifth house, governing progeny, intelligence, and devotion</note> makes a man have very few children, a devotee of the Lord of the Mountain Fort <note>referring to Shiva and Parvati</note>, endowed with comforts, yet confused and wandering. ॥ 5 ॥

In the Hindi commentary: He in whose fifth house the Sun sits is a devotee of Parvati and Shiva, is happy, but is lacking in good works and wealth, and is filled with confusion. ॥ 5 ॥

## Results of the Sun in the Sixth House—

The person will be endowed with constant happiness, a destroyer of enemies, possessed of courage, owner of beautiful vehicles, and of great majesty. Such a mortal becomes a minister to a king, provided the Sun is situated in a friendly sign rather than an enemy's sign. || 6 ||

<note>The sixth house is traditionally associated with debts, diseases, and enemies; the Sun here is said to "burn away" these obstacles.</note>

One who has the Sun in the sixth house is always happy, a vanquisher of foes, strong, possesses fine carriages, is extremely radiant, and serves as a minister to the sovereign. || 6 ||

---

## Results of the Sun in the Seventh House—

Devoid of wealth, with the luster of the body destroyed, accompanied by fear and disease, and of wicked character; such a man is emaciated by the pain of the King's wrath when the Lord of the Lotuses <note>original: "Padminisha" — an epithet for the Sun</note> is in the abode of women <note>the seventh house, governing marriage and partnerships</note>. || 7 ||

One who has the Sun in the seventh house is bereft of fortune, has a dull complexion, suffers from fear and illness, possesses a contemptible nature, and remains weak and distressed due to the anger of the government. || 7 ||

---

## Results of the Sun in the Eighth House—

Smallness of the eyes, an increase in the ranks of enemies, confusion of the intellect, and excessive anger in the person; there is a scarcity of wealth and particular emaciation of the limbs when the Lord of the Life of the Lotuses is in the place of longevity <note>the eighth house</note>. || 8 ||

One who has the Sun in the ninth house is detached from religious deeds, possesses a fine intellect, enjoys the happiness of sons and friends, but is hateful toward his mother's family. || 9 ||

<header>The Results of the Moon’s House Positions</header>

### Results of the Moon in the Second House (Wealth)—
> The person born with a full and powerful Moon in the second house will be endowed with happiness, children, and wealth, and will be of a humble nature. If the Moon is waning or weak, they will speak untruths, lack wealth, and possess little intelligence. One should judge the intensity of these results based on the Moon's specific strength. <note>original: "dvitiye" - the second house, traditionally associated with accumulated wealth, speech, and family.</note> || 2 ||

A person who has a full Moon in the house of wealth is blessed with comfort, progeny, and riches, and remains modest. If a waning Moon resides in the house of wealth, the individual tends to be dishonest in speech, poor, and of limited intellect. The results should be adjusted according to the varying strength of the Moon. || 2 ||

### Results of the Moon in the Third House (Siblings/Effort)—
> A person born with the "King of the Twice-born" <note>original: "dvijadhiraje" - a poetic title for the Moon, referring to its role as the lord of plants and Brahmins.</note> in the third house is prone to violence, filled with pride, miserly, and of small intellect; they depend upon their kinsmen and are devoid of both compassion and fear. || 3 ||

If the Moon is placed in the third house, the individual will be aggressive, arrogant, stingy, and possess little wisdom. They will rely on the support of relatives and lack feelings of mercy or healthy apprehension. || 3 ||

### Results of the Moon in the Fourth House (Home/Happiness)—
> The Moon in the fourth house <note>original: "patala-samstho" - literally 'residing in the underworld,' a technical term for the 4th house which is at the bottom of the zodiac chart.</note> at the time of birth grants wealth derived from water-related sources, success in agriculture, and the happiness of a wife, vehicles, and sons. It also creates devotion toward priests and deities. || 4 ||

One who has the Moon in the fourth house attains wealth from water-based industries, farming, and enjoys the comforts of a spouse, transport, and children. || 4 ||

### Results of the Moon in the Fifth House (Intellect/Children)—
> If the Moon is in the house of children <note>the 5th house</note> at birth, the person will have conquered their senses, speak the truth, and be of a cheerful disposition. They obtain all happiness through wealth and progeny, are good at accumulating resources, and possess a virtuous character. || 5 ||

One who has the Moon in the fifth house is self-controlled, truthful, happy, and finds joy through their children and finances. They are a collector of good things and are well-behaved. || 5 ||

### Results of the Moon in the Sixth House (Enemies/Health)—
The person will suffer from weak digestion <term>Mandagni: a term from Ayurvedic medicine meaning "slow fire," referring to a sluggish metabolism or poor digestive capacity</term>, be merciless, cruel, slightly lazy, harsh in speech, and have a wicked mind.

# The Results of Mercury’s House Positions

<page-num>103</page-num>
->The Results of Mercury in the Fourth House<-

When the son of the Cool-Rayed Moon <note>original: "shitalabhanusunau" - a poetic name for Mercury</note> is situated in the fourth house <note>the "Patala" or bottom of the sky, representing home and happiness</note>, the person is endowed with knowledge, ornaments, and means of travel. || 4 ||
One who has Mercury in the fourth house possesses beautiful vehicles, wealth, and grain; they are a lover of song and dance, a scholar, and adorned with jewelry. || 4 ||

### Results of Mercury in the Fifth House

The son of the Cool-Beamed One <note>Mercury</note> situated in the house of children <note>the fifth house</note> surely makes a person playful, possessed of the happiness of sons, having many friends, skilled in counsel <note>original: "mantravada" - can also refer to the science of spells or diplomacy</note>, and of good character. || 5 ||
If Mercury is in the fifth house, the person is happy regarding their children, possesses many friends, is skilled in deliberation, has a beautiful nature, and is fond of sport. || 5 ||

### Results of Mercury in the Sixth House

When the Moon’s son is in this enemy territory <note>the sixth house, which governs enemies and illness</note>, the person is fond of disputes, prone to illness, cruel-hearted, and their mind is distressed by a multitude of various enemies; they are constantly troubled by laziness. || 6 ||
If Mercury is in the sixth house, the person is quarrelsome, sickly, harsh, afflicted by enemies, and is always worried due to their own laziness. || 6 ||

### Results of Mercury in the Seventh House

When the Moon’s offspring goes to the house of desire <note>the seventh house, governing marriage and partnerships</note>, the person becomes decorated with beautiful character and majesty, and is devoted to truthful speech; they are joined with a wife, gold, and sons. || 7 ||
One who has Mercury sitting in the seventh house at the time of birth is of excellent character, endowed with prosperity, a speaker of truth, and possesses a wife, wealth, and sons. || 7 ||

### Results of Mercury in the Eighth House

If the Moon’s son is in the "cleft" <note>original: "randhre" - a technical term for the eighth house, associated with secrets and longevity</note> at birth, the person obtains all types of wealth through the favor of the King; however, they are a dissenter, highly arrogant, and a usurper of the efforts made by others. || 8 ||
If Mercury is sitting in the eighth house, the person attains all forms of property through the pleasure of the King <note>or government</note>, but is prone to opposition, extremely proud, and destroys the work done by others. || 8 ||

## The Results of Mercury in the Ninth House—

> This child of the Nectar-Rayed Moon <note>original: "amrita-kirana-janma" - an epithet for Mercury, the son of the Moon</note>, having arrived at the Abode of Merit <note>The 9th House, associated with fortune and religion</note>, makes a person especially joyful through the acquisition of followers, wealth, and children. Their mind is ever-inclined toward the performance of charity and they stand at the pinnacle of humanity. || 9 ||

One who has Mercury situated in the ninth house receives honor through their helpfulness and learning; they possess servants, wealth, and sons who bring them special joy, and they are generous in giving. || 9 ||

## The Results of Mercury in the Tenth House—

> When the Awakener <note>original: "bodhane" - Mercury, the planet of intellect</note> is present in the House of Honor <note>The 10th House, associated with career and status</note>, the person is wise and knowledgeable, performs excellent deeds, is endowed with various types of wealth, and is honored by kings. They possess the brilliance of playful, eloquent speech. || 10 ||

One who has Mercury situated in the tenth house is a man of knowledge who performs superior actions; he is possessed of many kinds of prosperity, is respected by the government <note>original: "raja" - traditionally 'king', but implies state authority</note>, is a beautiful speaker, and lives a life of comfort. || 10 ||

## The Results of Mercury in the Eleventh House—

> When the Son of the Cool-Rayed One <note>Mercury</note> is in the House of Gains, the person is attached to enjoyments, possesses immense wealth, is humble, eternally joyful, of beautiful character, and very strong. Such a human becomes a practitioner of various branches of learning. || 11 ||

One who has Mercury situated in the eleventh house is a person of pleasure, extremely wealthy, modest, always happy, of good nature, powerful, and a scholar of many sciences. || 11 ||

## The Results of Mercury in the Twelfth House—

> When the Son of the King of the Twice-Born <note>Mercury, son of the Moon</note> is positioned in the House of Expenditure, the man is devoid of compassion, abandoned by his own kinsmen, yet clever in his own affairs. He conquers his own side, is thoroughly knavish, and remains impure. || 12 ||

One who has Mercury situated in the twelfth house is heartless, rejected by his own people, but efficient in his own work; he overcomes his own associates, is crafty, and possesses a tarnished character. || 12 ||

<header>The Results of Jupiter’s Influence</header>

## Now, the results of Jupiter located in the First House (The Body)—

The man in whose birth chart the son of the Sage Angiras <note>original: "Chitrasikhandisunau," a poetic name for Jupiter</note> resides in the first house becomes endowed with knowledge, favored by kings, wise, deeply grateful, and exceedingly generous. Such a person shall possess a beautiful physical form. || 1 ||

If Jupiter is seated in the Ascendant <term>Lagna; the sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth</term>, the person is a student of the sciences, honored by royalty, possesses a refined intellect, is grateful, very liberal, and handsome. || 1 ||

---

## The results of Jupiter located in the Second House (Wealth)—

Possessed of a fine appearance, knowledge, virtue, and fame, even without enemies, such a man is venerable. He is charitable, of good character, and filled with riches when the Teacher of the Gods <note>original: "Girvanavandye," referring to Jupiter as the preceptor of the deities</note> has entered the house of wealth. || 2 ||

The person in whose second house Jupiter is seated is beautiful, endowed with the merits of learning and reputation, free from enemies, excellent, a donor, of a lovely disposition, and possessed of wealth. || 2 ||

---

## The results of Jupiter located in the Third House (Siblings/Valor)—

Devoid of kindness, miserly, ungrateful, and lacking in affection for wife and children; such a man suffers from weak digestion <term>Mandagni; a sluggish digestive fire in Ayurvedic terms</term> and physical weakness when the Priest of Indra <note>original: "Shakrapurohite," another title for Jupiter</note> is in the house of valor. || 3 ||

The individual in whose third house Jupiter is seated is lacking in courtesy, is stingy, ungrateful, bereft of love for wife and son, and is afflicted by slow digestion and weakness. || 3 ||

---

## The results of Jupiter located in the Fourth House (Home/Happiness)—

Always filled with joy through honors, various types of wealth, and vehicles; such a person attains prosperity through the compassion of the king when the Counselor of the Gods <note>original: "Maulibhrunmantrini"</note> is situated in the house of the earth <note>The 4th house represents land and foundations</note>. || 4 ||

He in whose fourth house Jupiter is seated becomes a recipient of respect, various kinds of riches and vehicles, and acquires wealth through the pleasure of the king. || 4 ||

---

## The results of Jupiter located in the Fifth House (Children/Intelligence)—

Good friends, excellent sons, mastery of the primary scriptures of counsel <term>Mantrashastra; the science of sacred chants or political advice</term>, and various riches and vehicles; Jupiter grants these, along with the charm of soft speech, when residing in the house of children at the time of birth. || 5 ||

### Results of Venus in the Eleventh House—

The person in whose eleventh house <note>The house of gains and income</note> Venus is situated will be deeply devoted to music and dance. ### Results of Venus in the Twelfth House—

They are of a conflicting nature, their mind is preoccupied with the worship of the god of love <note>sensuality</note>, and they are lacking in both compassion and truthfulness. || 12 ||

### Now, the Results of Saturn in the First House—

If at the time of birth the son of the Sun <note>Saturn</note> is in the Ascendant <note>The first house or 'Lagna'</note> while in its sign of exaltation <note>Libra</note> or its own sign <note>Capricorn or Aquarius</note>, it makes the man a ruler of a country or a city. In any other signs, Saturn in the first house makes one unfortunate, sickly, and impoverished. || 1 ||

### Results of Saturn in the Second House—

When the son of the Sun is in the house of wealth <note>The second house</note>, the person lives in the houses of others. They are afflicted by vices and abandoned by their kin, but later, in foreign lands, they attain vehicles and honors from kings. || 2 ||

### Results of Saturn in the Third House—

If the son of the Sun is in the third house <note>The house of siblings and courage</note>, the person is honored by kings and possesses fine vehicles. They become a village leader, highly courageous, and a protector of many people. || 3 ||

One who has Saturn seated in the **sixth house** is a conqueror of enemies, a connoisseur of good qualities, a follower of the commands of learned scholars, possesses a nourished body, and has a strong digestive fire <note>original: "jaṭharāgni" - the internal fire responsible for digestion and health</note>. || 6 ||

### Results of Saturn Situated in the Seventh House—

If Saturn is seated in the **seventh house**, the person becomes afflicted by diseases and thus has a wasted body; he is without a livelihood, is irritating to the minds of others, and is unhappy regarding his wife, home, and wealth. || 7 ||

## The Results of Saturn in the Eighth House—

<margin>1</margin>

> <note>original: "कुशतनुर्ननु दद्रुविचर्चिकाप्रभवतो..."</note> One who has Saturn situated in the eighth house <term>Eighth House: traditionally associated with longevity, secrets, and chronic illness</term> will possess a weak or emaciated body. They possess a wicked mind but are physically very attractive. || 9 ||

> <note>original: "दयाविहीनो विधनो व्ययार्तः..."</note> If the Son of the Sun is in the house of expenditure <term>Twelfth House: associated with loss, isolation, and the end of life</term> at birth, the man is devoid of compassion, lacks wealth, is troubled by expenses, and is perpetually lazy. He follows lowly people, suffers from bodily injuries, and is abandoned by all happiness. || 12 ||

One who has Saturn in the twelfth house is merciless, poor, distressed by expenses, lazy, a companion of the base, physically impaired, and devoid of all comforts. || 12 ||

<meta>This page continues the discussion of planetary influences, transitioning from the effects of Saturn to those of Rahu (the North Node of the Moon) across the various astrological houses.</meta>

<page-num>223</page-num>
-># The Results of Rahu's House Placement<-

The results that were previously stated for Saturn's placement in the various houses, starting from the Ascendant, should be understood to apply to Rahu as well; this is the consensus of the ancient Sages. || 13 ||

<note>The text establishes a traditional astrological rule: Rahu, being a "shadow planet," often mirrors the malefic and restrictive qualities of Saturn.</note>

Whatever results were described for Saturn in the twelve houses—beginning with the first house—the same should be known for Rahu. This is the opinion of the Sages. || 13 ||

### Regarding the Proportion of Results—

A planet situated in its sign of exaltation <term>Exaltation: the zodiac sign where a planet is at its maximum strength</term> bestows its full results. In its own sign or a friendly sign, it gives half the results. In an enemy's sign, it gives only a quarter, and if the planet is combust <term>Combust: appearing too close to the Sun to be seen, thereby losing its power</term>, it gives no result at all. || 14 ||

The results previously mentioned for the planets in the twelve houses are modified by their strength: if a planet is exalted, the result is full; if in its own or a friend's house, it is half; if in an enemy's house, it is one-fourth; and if it is set (combust), there is no effect. || 14 ||

### Now, the Results of Rahu in the First House (Ascendant)—

Rahu <note>original: "Tamas" or Darkness</note> in the first house makes a man wicked in nature and a deceiver of his own kinsmen. It causes headaches and a lustful temperament, yet grants victory in debates, even while the person remains sickly. || 1 ||

The person who has Rahu in their first house <term>Tanu Bhava: the house of the body or physical self</term> is of a wicked disposition, a cheater of his own relatives, suffers from head ailments, is highly sensual, wins in arguments, and is prone to illness. || 1 ||

### Results of Rahu in the Second House (Wealth)—

When the oppressor of the Sun and Moon <note>original: "Ravi-Chandra-Vimardano," a poetic name for Rahu as the cause of eclipses</note> is in the second house, the person becomes marked by talkativeness. It causes the destruction of wealth, leading to poverty and a life of wandering. || 2 ||

The person who has Rahu in the second house <term>Dhana Bhava: the house of wealth and speech</term> speaks very unpleasantly, destroys his own riches, is poor, and wanders about. || 2 ||

### Results of Rahu in the Third House (Siblings)—

In the third house, Rahu removes the fear of enemies, making the man famous in the world. He attains prosperity, wealth, happiness, and luxuries. However, it causes the death of brothers and loss of livestock, though he remains free from poverty.

### The Results of Rahu Situated in the Fourth House—

When the "Oppressor of the Sun and Moon" <note>original: "ravicandravimardane" — a poetic title for Rahu, the shadow planet responsible for eclipses.</note> enters the house of happiness, the person suffers the destruction of comfort. Such a man does not obtain the support of kinsmen or the joy of children and friends, and is destined to wander constantly. || 4 ||
The person in whose fourth house <note>The fourth house represents the home, mother, and emotional peace.</note> Rahu is seated experiences the loss of happiness; he is deprived of the joy of relatives, sons, and friends, and remains a perpetual traveler. || 4 ||

### The Results of Rahu Situated in the Fifth House—

Deprived of happiness and without the increase of friends, he suffers from the play of sharp pains in the abdomen. Indeed, the man then experiences confusion and wandering when the "Oppressor of the Sun and Moon" goes into the house of progeny. || 5 ||
The person in whose fifth house <note>The fifth house governs intelligence, creativity, and children.</note> Rahu is seated is devoid of happiness and friends, suffers from stomach ailments <term>udarashula: literally "stomach-spear," referring to colic or sharp abdominal pain</term>, and wanders aimlessly. || 5 ||

### The Results of Rahu Situated in the Enemy House—

The destruction of enemies, the arrival of wealth, but also the suffering of livestock and pain in the waist. A person attains great strength through association with outcasts if the "Darkness" <note>original: "tamah" — another name for Rahu as the shadow planet.</note> is in the sixth. || 6 ||
The person in whose sixth house <note>The sixth house relates to enemies, debts, and diseases.</note> Rahu is seated becomes free of enemies and gains wealth, but his livestock suffer, he has pain in his hips/waist, and he gains power through the company of foreigners or outcasts <term>mleccha: historically referring to non-Vedic or foreign peoples</term>. || 6 ||

### The Results of Rahu Situated in the Seventh House—

Conflict with a wife or indeed her loss; he obtains a woman of fierce form, filled with anger, prone to disputes, and afflicted by disease when "Darkness" is in the house of passion. || 7 ||
The person in whose seventh house <note>The seventh house governs marriage and partnerships.</note> Rahu is seated either has opposition with his wife or suffers the loss of his wife. Furthermore, his wife is angry, quarrelsome, and sickly. || 7 ||

### Results of Rahu in the Eighth House—

One who has Rahu in the tenth house is deprived of happiness from his father, is impoverished, but remains without enemies. He suffers from accidents with vehicles and is afflicted with <unclear>pain</unclear> from wind-disorders.

If Rahu is in Pisces in the fourth house <note>The "house of happiness"</note>, the person becomes a sufferer of hardships. || 10 ||

# Results of Ketu in the Houses

### Results of Ketu in the Fourth House

> If Ketu is in the fourth, there is never happiness from the mother or from the circle of friends; one meets destruction through the father.
> The one with the "Crested One" <note>original: "Shikhi," a name for Ketu referring to its comet-like tail</note> is bereft of kinsmen; even if in its exaltation or own sign, happiness does not last long, and there is always anxiety from all sides. || 4 ||

The person who has Ketu in their fourth house <note>the house of home, mother, and emotions</note> does not receive happiness from their mother or their circle of friends. There is loss caused by the father. They are deprived of the happiness of relatives. Even if Ketu is seated in its sign of exaltation or its own house, the person is happy for only a short time and is otherwise always filled with anxiety. || 4 ||

### Results of Ketu in the Fifth House

> When Ketu is born in the fifth for someone, they suffer pain in the stomach from injuries or falls.
> Such a man is dear to his kinsmen, possesses a good mind, has few sons, and is always wealthy and endowed with vigor. || 5 ||

The person who has Ketu seated in their fifth house <note>the house of intelligence and progeny</note> suffers distress in the stomach due to blows, falls, or similar injuries. They are beloved by their relatives, possess beautiful intellect, have few children, and are wealthy and strong. || 5 ||

### Results of Ketu in the Sixth House

> For one whose Ketu is situated in the sixth, there is the destruction of enemies,
> but there is a loss of honor from the mother's side of the family.
> There is happiness from four-legged animals, a great gain of wealth,
> and no disease in the body; there is always the destruction of ailments. || 6 ||

The person who has Ketu seated in their sixth house <note>the house of enemies, debt, and disease</note> sees the destruction of their enemies. However, they face disrespect from their mother's family. They enjoy the comforts of animals <note>historically referring to livestock or horses; modernly, pets or vehicles</note>, gain significant wealth, and remain free from disease as their ailments are always subdued. || 6 ||

### Results of Ketu in the Seventh House

# Now, the Chapter on the Results of Aspects.

> All planets look upon the third and tenth houses, the trines (fifth and ninth), the squares (fourth and eighth), and the seventh house with increasing strength of one quarter, two quarters, three quarters, and full strength respectively. However, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars—along with the others—have specific full aspects in a particular order. || 1 ||

Planets look at the 3rd and 10th houses from their position with one quarter vision <note>one 'charana' or 25% strength</note>, the 5th and 9th houses with two quarters vision <note>50% strength</note>, the 4th and 8th houses with three quarters vision <note>75% strength</note>, and the 7th house with four quarters (full) vision.

However, Saturn views the 3rd and 10th houses with full vision; Jupiter views the 5th and 9th houses with full vision; Mars views the 4th and 8th houses with full vision; and all planets view the 7th house with full vision. || 1 ||

### Results of the Moon's Aspect on the Sun in the House of Mars—

> If the Sun is situated in Aries or Scorpio and is aspected by the Moon, the person is charitable, righteous, possesses many servants, has a soft and pure body, and is fond of his home. || 2 ||

If the Sun is placed in Aries or Scorpio <note>the two zodiac signs ruled by Mars</note> and is seen by the Moon, the native is a donor, a follower of dharma, endowed with servants, possesses a beautiful and clean physique, and is a lover of his household. || 2 ||

### Results of Mars's Aspect on the Sun in the House of Mars—

> If the Sun is in the house of Mars and is aspected by Mars himself, the man is cruel, brave in the acts of war, has beautiful eyes and limbs, and is exceedingly powerful. || 3 ||

<note>The term 'Divamani' (Jewel of the Day) is used here as a poetic synonym for the Sun.</note>

# Chapter on the Visible Fruits of Planetary Aspects on the King

### Results of Saturn’s Aspect on the Sun in the House of the Moon—

The man born when the Day-Maker <note>The Sun</note> resides in the sign of the Cool-Rayed One <note>Cancer, ruled by the Moon</note> and is beheld by Saturn <note>original: "Manda," the slow-moving one</note> will suffer from phlegm and wind <note>The Ayurvedic humors Kapha and Vata</note>, be a backbiter, a creator of obstacles in the work of others, of a fickle nature, and possessive of much hair. || 25 ||

If the Sun is situated in Cancer and is seen by Saturn, the person is troubled by phlegm and wind, is a gossip, hinders the work of others, is restless, and is sickly. || 25 ||

---

### Results of the Moon’s Aspect on the Sun in Leo—

Cunning, profound, honored by the protector of the earth <note>The King</note>, endowed with wealth acquired through effort, and famous; such is the man born when the Friend <note>The Sun</note> is in his own domain <note>Leo</note> and is beheld by the Lord of the Stars <note>The Moon</note>. || 26 ||

If the Sun is situated in the sign of Leo and is seen by the Moon, the person is clever, serious, respected by royalty, becomes wealthy by earning money, and is well-known. || 26 ||

---

### Results of Mars’ Aspect on the Sun in Leo—

Loving many women, exceedingly cunning, of a phlegmatic nature, very cruel yet brave, a man of great exertion and a leader; such is the one born when the Sun stays in the Lion <note>Leo</note> and is seen by the Son of the Earth <note>Mars</note>. || 27 ||

If the Sun is situated in the sign of Leo and is seen by Mars, the person loves many women, is crafty, has a phlegmatic temperament, is sinful <note>or harsh</note>, powerful, very industrious, and a leader. || 27 ||

---

### Results of Mercury’s Aspect on the Sun in Leo—

Cunning, a follower of the King, possessing good strength, dear to the learned, and devoted to writing; such a man is born when the Day-Maker has entered the Lion and is beheld by the Gentle One <note>Mercury</note>. || 28 ||

If the Sun is situated in the sign of Leo and is seen by Mercury, the person is clever, a royal attendant, strong, beloved by scholars, and intent on writing. || 28 ||

---

### Results of Jupiter’s Aspect on the Sun in its Own House—

A builder of temples, gardens, ponds, and step-wells, and dear to his own kinsmen; such a man is born when the Sun, staying in the home of the King of Beasts <note>Leo</note>, is beheld by the Priest of the Gods <note>Jupiter</note>. || 29 ||

# Results of Aspects on the Moon.

### Results of Mars's aspect on the Moon in Leo —

> If the Moon, marked by the deer, resides in the Lion <note>Leo</note> and is gazed upon by the Son of the Earth <note>Mars</note>, the man becomes a minister to a king and is blessed with the happiness of wealth, vehicles, children, and a wife. || 26 ||

### Results of Mercury's aspect on the Moon in Leo —

> The King of the Twice-born <note>the Moon</note> staying in the King of Beasts <note>Leo</note>, when fully seen by the Son of the King of the Twice-born <note>Mercury</note>, makes a man filled with the joy of wealth, women, vehicles, and children. || 27 ||

### Results of Venus's aspect on the Moon in Virgo—

**The Moon situated in the sign of the Maiden <note>Virgo</note> and beheld by Venus <note>original: "Sita"</note> makes a man whose mind is intent on the playful dalliances of charming women, who relies upon his beloved, and who obtains wealth from kings.**

If the Moon is situated in the sign of Virgo and is aspected by Venus, the person born will be one who revels with women, remains under the shelter of a woman, and gains financial benefits from the sovereign.

### Results of Saturn's aspect on the Moon in Virgo—

**The Moon gone to the Maiden and seen by the son of the Sun <note>Saturn; original: "Arkasuta"</note> indeed makes one utterly destitute, of low intelligence, obtaining wealth through the support of women, and deprived of his mother.**

If the Moon is situated in the sign of Virgo and is aspected by Saturn, the person born is penniless, lacking in wisdom, acquires money through connections with women, and is bereft of the happiness or presence of a mother.

### Results of the Sun's aspect on the Moon in Libra—

**With the Moon in the Balance-bearer <note>Libra</note> aspected by the Sun, a man is constantly wandering, devoid of happiness and wealth, lacking a good wife and children, and greatly tormented by both friends and enemies.**

If the Moon is situated in the sign of Libra and is aspected by the Sun, the person born is of a wandering nature, lacks comfort and wealth, is without a wife or sons, and suffers distress caused by allies and foes alike.

### Results of Mars's aspect on the Moon in Libra—

**The Moon in Libra, when observed by the son of the Earth <note>Mars; original: "Dharanīsuta"</note>, makes the one born possess a mind solely intent on ruining the affairs of others through his intellect; he is full of deceit and tormented by sensual desires.**

If the Moon is situated in the sign of Libra and is aspected by Mars, the person born uses his intelligence to spoil the work of others, is a deceiver <note>or illusionist</note>, and remains troubled by worldly cravings.

### Results of Mercury's aspect on the Moon in Libra—

# From the Jātakābharaṇa —

> If the Moon is positioned in Libra at the time of birth and is aspected <note>aspected: in astrology, this refers to a specific angular relationship between planets that influences their effects</note> by Mercury, it makes the man a knower of the arts. || 39 ||

When the Moon is situated in the sign of Libra and is viewed by Mercury, the person born becomes a connoisseur of the arts, possessed of wealth and grain, an eloquent lecturer, and a rich man. || 39 ||

### Results of Jupiter’s aspect on the Moon in Libra —

> A man becomes expert in the purchase or sale of garments and ornaments if the Moon is in the sign of the Scales and is aspected by the Priest of the City of Indra <note>original: "sunāsīrapurohitena" — a poetic title for Jupiter, the preceptor of the gods</note>. || 40 ||

When the Moon is situated in the sign of Libra and is viewed by Jupiter, the person born is clever in the buying and selling of clothing, jewelry, and finery. || 40 ||

### Results of Venus’s aspect on the Moon in Libra —

> The man will be wise, having acquired wealth through many endeavors, and will be endowed with the favor of kings; he will have a robust body if the Moon in Libra is aspected by the son of Bhrigu <note>original: "bhṛgujena" — a name for Venus</note>. || 41 ||

When the Moon is situated in the sign of Libra and is viewed by Venus, the person born is a scholar, one who accumulates wealth in many ways, a recipient of royal favor, and possesses a well-nourished, sturdy physique. || 41 ||

### Results of Saturn’s aspect on the Moon in Libra —

> Though joined with wealth, grain, and excellent vehicles, the man may be deprived of the enjoyment of sensory pleasures if the Moon is in Libra at the time of birth and is aspected by the son of the Sun <note>original: "bhānutanūja" — a name for Saturn</note>. || 42 ||

When the Moon is situated in the sign of Libra and is viewed by Saturn, the person born—despite being endowed with money, food-stores, and fine carriages—remains devoid of the actual enjoyment of worldly pleasures. || 42 ||

### Results of the Sun’s aspect on the Moon in Scorpio —

> The Moon in Scorpio aspected by the Sun makes a man devoid of good conduct, yet wealthy, unbearable to other people, one who exerts extreme effort, and a resident of military camps. || 43 ||

If there is an aspect of the Sun upon the Moon situated in the sign of Scorpio, the person born is lacking in proper behavior, wealthy, disliked by people, highly industrious, and a soldier. || 43 ||

# The Results of Planetary Aspects on the Moon

The Lord of the Stars <note>original: "Taraswami" - the Moon</note> traveling in the Bow <note>original: "Chapagami" - Sagittarius</note> at birth, having attained the aspect of the Minister of the Daityas <note>original: "Daityamatya" - Venus</note>... (53)
If the Moon is situated in the sign of Sagittarius and is aspected by Venus, the person born is endowed with children, wealth, and righteousness <term>Dharma: the path of virtue and duty</term>, and remains eternally happy. (53)

->The result of Saturn’s aspect on the Moon situated in Sagittarius:<-

Endowed with strength, ever-devoted to the sacred sciences, truthful, and a fierce man; such is the one born when the Cold-Rayed One <note>the Moon</note> stays in the Bow <note>Sagittarius</note> and is seen by the son of the Sharp-Rayed One <note>original: "Tikshnarashmi-atmaja" - Saturn, son of the Sun</note>. (54)
If the Moon is in the sign of Sagittarius and is aspected by Saturn, the person born is powerful, a student of the sciences <term>Shastras: classical scriptures or treatises</term>, a speaker of truth, and majestic. (54)

->The result of the Sun’s aspect on the Moon situated in Capricorn:<-

Bereft of wealth, soiled, fond of wandering, with a destroyed intellect, and a truly sorrowful mind; such a man is produced if the Snow-Rayed One <note>the Moon</note> is in the Crocodile <note>original: "Makara" - Capricorn</note> and his body is viewed by the Day-Maker <note>the Sun</note>. (55)
If the Moon is in the sign of Capricorn and is aspected by the Sun, the person born is poor, unclean, restless/wandering, witless, and miserable. (55)

->The result of Mars’s aspect on the Moon situated in Capricorn:<-

Exceedingly fierce, rich in wealth and vehicles, wise, and joined with the happiness of wife and children; such a man enjoys great splendor when the Deer-Marked One <note>original: "Mriganka" - the Moon</note> is in the Deer <note>Capricorn</note> and seen by the Son of the Earth <note>original: "Avanija" - Mars</note>. (56)
If the Moon is in the sign of Capricorn and is aspected by Mars, the person born is very majestic, possesses wealth and transport, is a scholar <term>Pandit: a learned teacher or expert</term>, and is happy through his wife and sons, possessing great dignity. (56)

->The result of Mercury’s aspect on the Moon situated in Capricorn:<-

Devoid of intelligence, poor, having abandoned his home, and deserted by his wife and kin; such is the man when the Cold-Rayed One <note>the Moon</note> is in the sign of Saturn <note>Capricorn</note> and is beheld by the son of the Nectar-Rayed One <note>original: "Piyushamshora-atmaja" - Mercury, son of the Moon</note>. (57)
If the Moon is in the sign of Capricorn and is aspected by Mercury, the person born is unintelligent, poor, a renouncer of his home, and is without wife or sons. (57)

->The result of Jupiter’s aspect on the Moon situated in Capricorn:<-

The son of a king, truthful, a connoisseur of virtues, and joined with wife and children...

# From the Jatakabharana—

If the Lord of the Night <note>the Moon</note> is in the face of the Deer <note>the sign of Capricorn</note> and is aspected by the Lord of Speech <note>Jupiter</note>: || 58 ||

If Jupiter looks upon the Moon while it is situated in the sign of Capricorn, the person born is a prince <note>or of royal status</note>, a speaker of truth, a connoisseur of virtues, and is blessed with a wife and sons. || 58 ||

### The result of Venus aspecting the Moon in Capricorn—

> One becomes a man with beautiful eyes, endowed with wealth and vehicles, and happy with children, ornaments, and fine clothing; indeed, this occurs when the Friend of the Night-blooming Lotus <note>the Moon</note> stays in the Deer <note>Capricorn</note> and is seen by the Son of Bhrigu <note>Venus</note>. || 59 ||

If Venus looks upon the Moon situated in the sign of Capricorn, the person has beautiful eyes, possesses wealth and vehicles, and remains happy with sons, jewelry, and garments. || 59 ||

### The result of Saturn aspecting the Moon in Capricorn—

> One becomes very lazy, of meager wealth, untruthful, soiled, and overwhelmed by vices; this happens if the Form of Nectar <note>the Moon</note> resides in the Crocodile <note>Capricorn</note> while being observed by the Son of the Three-Formed One <note>Saturn</note>. || 60 ||

If the Moon is situated in Capricorn and is seen by Saturn, the person born is very lazy, possesses little wealth, is a speaker of untruths, is unclean, and is addicted to vices. || 60 ||

### The result of the Sun aspecting the Moon in Aquarius—

> A man becomes an agriculturist, associated with deceit, dependent on a king, and devoted to righteousness; this occurs if the Form of Nectar <note>the Moon</note> enters the Water-Pot <note>Aquarius</note> and is observed by the Lord of the Day-lotuses <note>the Sun</note>. || 61 ||

If the Sun looks upon the Moon situated in the sign of Aquarius, the person born is a farmer, a rogue, a dependent of the king, and remains engaged in religious duties. || 61 ||

### The result of Mars aspecting the Moon in Aquarius—

> He suffers separation from his wealth, home, mother, and father; he produces very difficult or uneven objects and talks excessively. Such a mortal is indeed of a dirty mind and an extreme rogue when the Moon has gone to the Pitcher <note>Aquarius</note> and is seen by the Son of the Earth <note>Mars</note>. || 62 ||

## The result of Mercury's aspect on the Moon in Aquarius—

> One who possesses the pleasures of the senses, takes great delight in food, is exceedingly pure, and speaks kindly.
> Such a person respects women, music, and good ethics when the Moon in Aquarius is seen by Mercury. || 63 ||

If the Moon is situated in the sign of Aquarius and is aspected by Mercury, the subject is engaged in sensual pleasures, fond of eating, very holy <note>original: "shuchi," implying ritual or internal purity</note>, a sweet talker, and holds respect for women, music, and moral conduct. || 63 ||

## The result of Jupiter's aspect on the Moon in Aquarius—

> Happiness from lands, cities, and villages; endowed with enjoyments and the tendencies of virtuous people.
> The Moon in Aquarius, seen by the teacher of the gods <note>Jupiter</note>, makes a man most excellent. || 64 ||

If the Moon is situated in the sign of Aquarius and is aspected by Jupiter, the subject enjoys the pleasures of the earth, cities, and villages; he is a seeker of enjoyment, beloved by the virtuous, and becomes highly distinguished. || 64 ||

## The result of Venus's aspect on the Moon in Aquarius—

> Bereft of the happiness of friends, children, wives, and home; miserable and cast out from honor by the people.
> This occurs when the Moon is held in Aquarius at birth and is beheld by the one worshiped by the demons <note>Venus</note>. || 65 ||

If the Moon is situated in the sign of Aquarius and is aspected by Venus, the subject is devoid of the happiness derived from friends, sons, wives, and the home; he is sorrowful and lacks dignity. || 65 ||

If the Moon is situated in the sign of Aquarius and is aspected by Saturn, the subject gains from donkeys, camels, and young horses; he is devoted to base women and acts in opposition to religious law <term>Dharma: the moral and cosmic order</term>. || 66 ||

### The Result of the Sun's Aspect on the Moon in Pisces

> When the Moon is situated in the sign of Pisces and is aspected <note>In Vedic astrology, an 'aspect' or 'drishti' refers to a planet 'looking at' or influencing another from a specific distance.</note> by the Sun, it brings about an excellence of desire, great happiness, the status of a commander, a vast increase in wealth, and the successful completion of good deeds. || 67 ||

If the Moon, located in the sign of Pisces, is viewed by the Sun, the native <note>The person whose birth chart is being read.</note> becomes highly passionate, a leader of armies, experiences growth in wealth, and achieves success in his undertakings. || 67 ||

If the Moon, located in the sign of Pisces, is viewed by Mars, the native is defeated by enemies, loves women of ill-repute, is unhappy, and is a sinner. || 68 ||

> There is surely a loss of wealth through evil vices, and constant misfortunes shall arise;
> For men, when Mars is seen by Venus while staying in the sign of Cancer. || 23 ||

If Mars, located in the sign of Cancer, is aspected by Venus, the person born will destroy their wealth through bad habits and will constantly be the cause of calamities. || 23 ||

### The result of Saturn's aspect on Mars in Cancer—

> Possessing wealth such as water-products and grain, having a beautiful luster, a man who obtains wealth from the lord of the earth;

If Mars, located in the sign of Cancer, is aspected by Saturn, the person born possesses wealth derived from water <note>such as pearls or maritime trade</note>, is handsome, and receives wealth from the king. || 24 ||

> A doer of good for those he likes, surely a giver of misery to his enemies;

If there is an aspect of the Sun upon Mars located in the sign of Leo, the person born is a benefactor to his friends and a source of displeasure to his enemies. || 25 ||

# The Results of Aspects on Mars

->The result of the Moon’s aspect on Mars situated in Leo:<-

# Results of Aspects on Mercury

Mercury, situated in the house of the Son of the Earth <note>original: "Kshitisunu" - a name for Mars</note>, when aspected by the Sun, makes the person born under this sign affectionate toward relatives, truthful, and honored by the King. ॥ 1 ॥

If Mercury is placed in Aries or Scorpio and is aspected by the Sun, the native <term>Jataka; the person whose horoscope is being read</term> is a lover of his kinsmen, speaks the truth, and possesses dignity granted by the King. ॥ 1 ॥

### Results of the Moon's Aspect on Mercury in the House of Mars—

One who is exceedingly fond of fine music and dance, a lover of beautiful women, possessed of vehicles and servants, yet possessing a streak of deceit; such is the one born when the Son of the Moon <note>original: "Somatmaja" - Mercury</note> is in the sign of Mars and aspected by the Cool-Rayed One <note>original: "Sheetakara" - the Moon</note>. ॥ 2 ॥

If Mercury, located in Aries or Scorpio, is aspected by the Moon, the native is interested in song and dance, is a lover of women, possesses vehicles and servants, and is crafty. ॥ 2 ॥

### Results of Mars's Aspect on Mercury in the House of Mars—

Mercury in the sign of Mars, aspected by the Son of the Earth <note>Mars</note>, produces a man who is dear to the King, very wealthy, brave, skilled in the arts, prone to quarrels, and possessed by hunger. ॥ 3 ॥

If Mercury, located in Aries or Scorpio, is aspected by Mars, the native is a favorite of the King, extremely wealthy, brave, clever in the arts, quarrelsome, and a hearty eater <note>literally: "one who eats much"</note>. ॥ 3 ॥

### Results of Jupiter's Aspect on Mercury in the House of Mars—

The Son of the Moon <note>Mercury</note> traveling in the house of Mars and aspected by the Lord of Speech <note>original: "Vakpati" - Jupiter</note> makes a mortal endowed with happiness, clever, of beautiful speech, accompanied by wife and sons, and cheerful. ॥ 4 ॥

If Mercury, located in the sign of Aries or Scorpio, is aspected by Jupiter, the native is happy, clever, a beautiful speaker, possessed of a wife and sons, and is joyful. ॥ 4 ॥

### Results of Venus's Aspect on Mercury in the House of Mars—

Mercury staying in the sign of Mars and being observed by Venus makes the one born characterized by the enjoyment of women, rich in virtues and dignity, dear to friends, of beautiful intellect, and humble. ॥ 5 ॥

If Mercury, following the signs of Aries or Scorpio, is aspected by Venus, the native—

If Jupiter is situated in Gemini or Virgo and is aspected by Venus, the person born will be happy with the joys of wealth, a wife, and sons; he will be one who builds mansions, constructs reservoirs <note>original: "vapi-kupa"; step-wells and ponds</note>, engages in agriculture, and remains cheerful. || 17 ||

### **The result of Jupiter in a sign of Mercury aspected by Saturn—**

> It makes a man endowed with great honor from the king, always celebrating festivals, and delightful with full virtues. Jupiter, when seen by Saturn in this house, makes a man the lord of a city or a village. || 18 ||

If Jupiter is situated in Gemini or Virgo and is aspected by Saturn, the person born will receive honor from the king, will constantly organize festivals, will be virtuous, and will be the ruler of a city or village. || 18 ||

### **The result of Jupiter in Cancer aspected by the Sun—**

> First, there is a loss of happiness arising from wife, children, and wealth, but surely afterwards those joys come. Indeed, for men, the teacher of the gods <note>Jupiter</note> situated in Cancer and aspected by the Sun acts thus. || 19 ||

If Jupiter is situated in the sign of Cancer and is aspected by the Sun, the person born is first deprived of the happiness of a wife, sons, and wealth, but later becomes endowed with these joys. || 16 || <note>The original text prints '16' here; it is likely a misprint for '19'.</note>

If Saturn is situated in the sign of Gemini or Virgo and is aspected by Jupiter, the person born will live under the patronage of a King, will be possessed of excellent qualities, beloved by holy men, will keep secret wealth, and will be wise and strong-willed. ||17||
