The person at whose birth the Lord of the Ascendant <note>The planet ruling the rising sign</note> is situated in the tenth or fourth house is endowed with the happiness of parents, possesses many brothers, is lustful, and is gifted with good qualities and a beautiful form. ॥ 4 ॥

### Next, the result of the Lord of the Ascendant in the fifth house—

> If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the fifth, the person is proud, has moderate happiness from sons, suffers the loss of the first child, is quick to anger, and has access to the royal court. ॥ 5 ॥

The person at whose birth the Lord of the Ascendant is situated in the fifth house <note>The house of intelligence and children</note> is honorable, receives ordinary happiness from his son, is deprived of his first child, is irritable, and is one who enters the assembly of the King. ॥ 5 ॥

### Next, the result of the Lord of the Ascendant in the seventh house—

> For one whose Lord of the Ascendant is in the seventh, his wife does not live long; he is either detached, a traveler, poor, or even a king. ॥ 6 ॥

The person at whose birth the Lord of the Ascendant is situated in the seventh house <note>The house of marriage and partnerships</note> finds that his wife does not live—that is, she meets death very quickly—and that man is either detached from the world, a wanderer in foreign lands, impoverished, or a ruler. ॥ 6 ॥

### Next, the result of the Lord of the Ascendant in the eighth and twelfth houses—

> If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the twelfth or eighth, the person is skilled in the arts and crafts, a gambler, a thief, extremely wrathful, and a frequent enjoyer of others' wives. ॥ 7 ॥

The person at whose birth the Lord of the Ascendant is situated in the eighth <note>The house of longevity/death</note> or twelfth house <note>The house of loss/expenditure</note> is an expert in painting and various sciences, a gambler, a thief, excessively angry, and one who frequently pursues the wives of others. ॥ 7 ॥

### Next, the result of the Lord of the Ascendant in the ninth house—

> If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the ninth, the creature is fortunate, a favorite of kings, a devotee of Vishnu, clever, eloquent, and endowed with sons, wife, and wealth. ॥ 8 ॥

The person at whose birth the Lord of the Ascendant is situated in the ninth house <note>The house of fortune and religion</note> is lucky, beloved by kings, a devotee of Lord Vishnu, clever in speech, and possesses sons, a wife, and wealth. ॥ 8 ॥

### Results of the Lord of the Fourth House in the Third or Eleventh House
The Lord of Happiness <note>original: "Sukhesha" - the ruler of the 4th house, which governs domestic happiness and property</note> situated in the third or eleventh house makes a person constantly prone to illness yet wealthy. Such a person is generous, virtuous, a donor, and possesses wealth earned through their own physical efforts <note>literally "earned by one's own arms"</note>. || 7 ||
If at the time of birth the Lord of the Fourth is seated in the third or eleventh house, that person is always joined with disease, but is wealthy, generous, virtuous, wise, and becomes rich through wealth produced by their own hands. || 7 ||

### Results of the Lord of the Fourth House in the Second House
Endowed with all kinds of prosperity, honorable, courageous, and possessing the happiness of land <note>original: "kusukhanvitah" - 'ku' refers to the earth or land</note>; joined with family and a seeker of enjoyments when the Lord of the Fourth is in the second house. || 8 ||
For the native in whose birth chart the Lord of the Fourth sits in the second house, they are endowed with all riches, honorable, brave, happy regarding land, surrounded by family, and an enjoyer of life's pleasures. || 8 ||

## Now, the Results of the Lord of the Fifth House

### First, the Lord of the Fifth House in the Fifth House
He whose Lord of Sons <note>original: "Sutesha" - the ruler of the 5th house, governing children and intelligence</note> is in the fifth, his son does not live. He is momentary <note>likely meaning impulsive or valuing every moment</note>, a harsh speaker, yet remains righteous and intelligent. || 1 ||
At the time of birth, if the Lord of the Fifth is seated in the fifth house, that person's son does not survive. Furthermore, he utilizes even a single moment for his work, speaks harsh words, is a soul of dharma <note>righteousness</note>, and is wise. || 1 ||

### Results of the Lord of the Fifth House in the Sixth or Twelfth House
If the Lord of Sons is in the sixth or the twelfth house, the son attains the status of an enemy. Or, due to the death of a son, one may have an adopted son or a son purchased through wealth. || 2 ||
At the time of birth, if the Lord of the Fifth is seated in the sixth or twelfth house, there is enmity with that person's son or the death of the son occurs. After the death of a son, he makes a son through adoption or by giving money. || 2 ||

### Results of the Lord of the Fifth House in the Seventh House
When the Lord of Sons is in the house of desire <note>the 7th house</note>, the person is honorable and endowed with truth and righteousness. If it is in an exalted position, he becomes a leader of men through the power of his singular devotion. || 3 ||
For the native in whose birth chart the Lord of the Fifth is situated in the seventh house, he is honorable, a speaker of truth, and a righteous soul. If the Lord of the Fifth is in its sign of exaltation, he becomes a master of people (a king) through the majesty of his devotion. || 3 ||

### Results of the Lord of the Fifth House in the Eighth and Second Houses—

### Results of the Lord of the Fifth House in the Ninth and Tenth Houses—

> If the Lord of the Fifth is in the Ninth or the Sky <note>original: "Khe" (Sky), referring to the 10th house or Midheaven</note>, the son will be like a king. Alternatively, the person will be an author, famous, and the light of their lineage. || 5 ||

### Results of the Lord of the Fifth House in the Fourth House—

> If the Lord of the Fifth is in the Mother's House, there will be long-lasting happiness from the mother. The person is endowed with prosperity, fine intellect, and serves as a minister or a teacher. || 8 ||

One in whose birth chart the Lord of the Fifth House is seated in the Fourth house <note>Matru-bhavana: the house of the mother and comforts</note> enjoys happiness from their mother for a long time, is possessed of wealth, has a refined intellect, and becomes a minister to a king or a preceptor. || 8 ||

### Now, the Results of the Lord of the Sixth House.

### First, the Results of the Lord of the Sixth House in the House of Enemies—

> If the Lord of the Sixth is situated in the House of Enemies, one's own kinsmen become like enemies.

# Appendix

> One’s own kin become enemies, while strangers surely become friends on this earth. || 1 ||
<note>original: "परज्ञातिर्भेवेन्मित्रं भूमौ न चलति ध्रुवम्"</note>

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Sixth House is situated in the Sixth House itself, then the person's own relatives act like enemies, while the relatives of others act like friends, and he certainly does not wander <note>The Sanskrit 'na chalati' suggests stability or not being a wanderer</note>. || 1 ||

**Next, the results of the Lord of the Sixth House being in the Seventh or Eleventh House—**

> If the Lord of the Sixth is in the Seventh, the Eleventh, or the Ascendant, one possesses livestock, is wealthy, virtuous, honored, courageous, but devoid of sons. || 2 ||
<note>original: "षष्ठेशे सप्तमे लाभे लग्ने वा पशुमान् भवेत् । धनवान् गुणवान् मानी साहसी पुत्रवर्जितः॥"</note>

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Sixth House is seated in the Seventh <term>Saptama; the house of partnership</term> or the Eleventh House <term>Ekadasha; the house of gains</term>, then that person is endowed with animals <note>historically a sign of agricultural wealth</note>, is wealthy, virtuous, respected, brave, and childless. || 2 ||

**Next, the results of the Lord of the Sixth House being in the Twelfth or Eighth House—**

> If the Lord of the Sixth is in the Eighth or the Twelfth, one is sickly, an enemy to the wise, an adulterer, and intent on harming living beings. || 3 ||
<note>original: "षष्ठेशेऽष्टमरिःफस्थे रोगी शत्रुर्मनीषिणाम् । परजायाभिगामी च जीवहिंसासु तत्परः ॥"</note>

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Sixth House is seated in the Eighth or Twelfth House, the person is sickly, an enemy of scholars, a pursuer of others' wives, and one who kills living creatures. || 3 ||

**Next, the results of the Lord of the Sixth House being in the Ninth House—**

> He in whose Ninth House the Lord of the Sixth sits becomes a seller of wood and stone; in business, there is surely sometimes loss and sometimes growth. || 4 ||
<note>original: "षष्ठेशो नवमे यस्य काष्ठपाषाणविक्रयी । व्यवहारे कश्चिद्धानिः कचिद्वृद्धिर्भवेत्किल ॥"</note>

For the native in whose birth chart the Lord of the Sixth House is seated in the Ninth House <term>Navama; the house of fortune and religion</term>, he becomes a seller of wood and stone. Furthermore, in his trade, he experiences loss in some places and growth in others.

**Next, the results of the Lord of the Sixth House being in the Second or Tenth House—**

> If the Lord of the Sixth is in the Tenth or the Second, one is courageous, famous in the lineage, a traveler to foreign lands, pure, a speaker, and single-mindedly devoted to one's own duties. || 5 ||
<note>original: "षष्ठेशे कर्मवित्तस्थे साहसी कुलविश्रुतः । परदेशी शुचिर्वक्ता स्वधर्मेष्वेकनिष्ठकः ॥"</note>

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Sixth House is seated in the Second <term>Dvitiya; the house of wealth</term> or the Tenth House <term>Dashama; the house of profession</term>, then that person is courageous, famous within his family, a foreigner <note>or one who lives abroad</note>, pure, an eloquent speaker, and a believer in his own religion/duty. || 5 ||

**Next, the results of the Lord of the Sixth House being in the Third or Fourth House—**

> If the Lord of the Sixth is in the Third or the Fourth, one is wrathful, red-eyed, high-minded, a slanderer, unrighteous, fickle-minded, and extremely wealthy. || 6 ||
<note>original: "षष्ठेशे सहजे तुर्ये क्रोधनो रक्तलोचनः । मनस्वी पिशुनोऽधर्मी चलचित्तोऽतिवित्तवान् ॥"</note>

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Sixth House is seated in the Third or Fourth House, then that native is angry, has red eyes, is intellectual, a backbiter, unrighteous, has a restless mind, and is exceedingly wealthy. || 6 ||

### Next, the result of the Lord of the Sixth House in the Fifth House:

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Sixth House <note>The house associated with enemies, debt, and illness</note> is situated in the Fifth House <note>The house of children, intelligence, and past merits</note>, then that person has a fickle circle of friends and fluctuating wealth. They are of a phlegmatic temperament <note>original: "kaphi" - referring to an imbalance of the Kapha dosha in Ayurveda</note>, but remain happy and possess a beautiful nature. ### Now, the results of the Lord of the Seventh House.

### First, the result of the Lord of the Seventh House in the Seventh House:

> If the Lord of the Seventh stays in the Seventh, one is lustful toward others' wives;

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Seventh House <note>The house of marriage and partnerships</note> is situated in the Seventh House itself, then that person pursues the wives of others. They are harsh in their speech, yet possess fortitude, and are unable to keep any secret hidden within their heart. || 1 ||

### Next, the result of the Lord of the Seventh House in the Eighth House:

> If the Lord of the Wife is in the Eighth or Sixth, the wife shall be full of resentment;
> Or the man himself becomes wrathful and nowhere finds happiness. || 2 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Seventh House is seated in the Eighth or Sixth House, then his wife will be prone to anger. Alternatively, the man himself becomes very angry and remains perpetually devoid of happiness. || 2 ||

### Next, the result of the Lord of the Seventh House in the Second or Ninth House:

> If the Lord of the Seventh is in the Ninth or Second, there is union with many women;
> An initiator who procrastinates, with a mind fixed only on women. || 3 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Seventh House is seated in the Second or Ninth House <note>The original Sanskrit verse mentions the 9th and 2nd, while the Hindi commentary mentions the 2nd or 7th; the verse is generally prioritized in translation</note>, then that man consorts with many women. He begins small tasks but takes a long time to finish them <term>procrastinator: original "dirghasutri" - one who stretches out work</term>, and his mind is always directed toward women. || 3 ||

### Next, the result of the Lord of the Seventh House in the Fourth House:

> If the Lord of the Seventh is in the Tenth or Fourth, his wife is devoted and chaste;
> He is righteous and truthful, though suffering only from wind-disorders. || 4 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Seventh House is seated in the Fourth or Tenth House, then his wife is exceptionally devoted <term>chaste wife: original "pativrata"</term>. The man himself is righteous, a speaker of truth, and suffers only from "wind" ailments <note>original: "vata roga" - conditions like rheumatism, bloating, or gout in Ayurvedic medicine</note>. || 4 ||

### Next, the result of the Lord of the Seventh House in the Third or Eleventh House:

### Results of the Lord of the Ninth House in the Tenth and Fourth Houses:

> If the Lord of Fortune is in the tenth or fourth house, one becomes a minister or a commander.
> They are virtuous, possess livestock, are courageous, and free from anger. || 2 ||

One in whose birth chart the Lord of the Ninth <note>The Ninth House represents fortune, religion, and father.</note> is seated in the Tenth House <note>The house of career and public life.</note> becomes a minister or a general. Furthermore, they are meritorious, a keeper of animals, brave, and devoid of temper. || 2 ||

### Results of the Lord of the Ninth House in the Fifth and Eleventh Houses:

> If the Lord of Fortune is in the fifth or eleventh house, one is fortunate and beloved by the people.
> Devoted to the service of the Guru, honorable, and endowed with the qualities of patience and generosity. || 3 ||

The native in whose birth chart the Lord of the Ninth has gone to the Fifth or Eleventh House is fortunate, dear to all, engaged in devotion to their teacher, respected, and possessed of the virtues of steadiness and nobility. || 3 ||

### Results of the Lord of the Ninth House in the Sixth, Eighth, and Twelfth Houses:

> If the Lord of Fortune is in the house of the maternal uncle <note>original: "matule" referring to the 6th house</note> or the house of loss <note>original: "risphe" referring to the 12th house</note>, or the eighth, one is luckless.
> There is no happiness from the maternal uncle, nor happiness from the elder brother. || 4 ||

The native in whose birth chart the Lord of the Ninth is seated in the Sixth, Eighth, or Twelfth House <note>These are considered "Dusthanas" or difficult houses in Vedic astrology.</note> is deprived of fortune, lacks the happiness of a maternal uncle, and [similarly lacks] happiness from an elder brother. || 4 ||

### Results of the Lord of the Ninth House in the First and Seventh Houses:

> If the Lord of Fortune is in the seventh or the first house <note>original: "kalpe" referring to the 1st house/Ascendant</note>, one is virtuous and possesses livestock.
> Sometimes there is no success in the work one desires to do. || 5 ||

The native in whose birth chart the Lord of the Ninth is seated in the Seventh or the First House is virtuous and owns animals, yet whatever work they desire to perform is sometimes never accomplished. || 5 ||

### Results of the Lord of the Ninth House in the Second and Third Houses:

> If the Lord of Fortune is in the third or the second house, one is always contemplating their fortune.
> Wealthy, virtuous, lustful, a scholar, and beloved by the people. || 6 ||

The native in whose birth chart the Lord of the Ninth is seated in the Second or Third House is one who praises their own luck, is wealthy, talented, sensual, and a favorite of everyone.

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Tenth House is seated in the Ascendant <note>Lagna; the first house representing the self</note>, then that person is a composer of poetry; he is sickly in his childhood but happy later in life, and his wealth increases day by day. || 6 ||

## The results of the Lord of the Tenth House located in the Second, Third, and Seventh Houses:

> If the Lord of the Tenth <note>original: "Karmesha" - the planet ruling the house of action and career</note> is situated in the house of wealth, the house of passion, or the house of siblings; the person will be wise, virtuous, eloquent, and endowed with truth and righteousness. || 7 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Tenth is seated in the Second, Third, or Seventh house, then that person is virtuous, high-minded, a skilled orator, and joined with truth and religious duty. || 7 ||

# Now, the results of the Lord of the Eleventh House.

## First, the results of the Lord of the Eleventh House located in the Eleventh House:

> When the Lord of Gains <note>original: "Labhesha" - the planet ruling the house of income and desires</note> is situated in the house of gains, he certainly becomes eloquent. His scholarship and poetic ability increase day by day. || 1 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Eleventh is seated in the Eleventh house, then his scholarship and power of poetic composition continue to grow every day. || 1 ||

## Then, the results of the Lord of the Eleventh House located in the Twelfth House:

> If the Lord of the Place of Acquisition is in the house of loss <note>original: "Rishpha" - the 12th house of expenditure and liberation</note>, he associates with foreigners <note>original: "Mlechha" - historically referring to non-Vedic or foreign peoples</note>. He is lustful, very handsome, fickle, and a slave to his desires. || 2 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Eleventh is seated in the Twelfth house, then that person associates with foreigners, is lustful, very beautiful, restless, and addicted to sensual pleasures. || 2 ||

## Then, the results of the Lord of the Eleventh House located in the Ascendant:

> When the Lord of Gains is situated in the Ascendant <note>original: "Lagna" - the 1st house representing the self</note>, one becomes wealthy, greatly virtuous, and pure. He has an equal vision toward all, is a great orator, and is always fond of play. || 3 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Eleventh is seated in the Ascendant, he is wealthy, highly pure-minded <note>original: "Sattvic" - possessing the quality of goodness and harmony</note>, looks upon everyone with an equal eye, is a speaker, and is always joyful or fond of amusements. || 3 ||

## Then, the results of the Lord of the Eleventh House located in the Second and Fifth Houses:

> If the Lord of Gains is in the house of wealth or the house of the son, he is endowed with various kinds of happiness. He possesses sons, is righteous, and grants the accomplishment of all goals. || 4 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Eleventh is seated in the Second or Fifth house, then that person is joined with various types of happiness, has children, is religious, and is the achiever of all tasks. || 4 ||

## Then, the results of the Lord of the Eleventh House located in the Third and Fourth Houses:

> If the Lord of Gains is in the house of siblings or the fourth house, he is a great man devoted to pilgrimages. He is skillful in all works but suffers from sharp piercing pains <note>original: "Shula-roga" - often referring to colic or sharp abdominal pain</note>. || 5 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Eleventh is seated in the Third or Fourth house, then he is one who visits holy pilgrimage sites, is clever in all works, and is afflicted with colic pain. || 5 ||

<note>Technical Vocabulary:
- Tenth Lord (Dashamesha): The planet ruling the 10th house of career.
- Eleventh Lord (Ekadashesha/Labhesha): The planet ruling the 11th house of gains.
- House (Bhava): An astrological house.
- Appendix (Parishishta): Supplementary material at the end of the book.
- Foreigner (Mlechha): Someone outside the traditional social or religious order.
- Pure (Sattvic): Characterized by clarity, goodness, and light.
- Colic (Shula-roga): A medical condition involving sharp, stabbing pain.</note>

### Results of the Lord of the Eleventh House in the Sixth House

> The Lord of Gains <note>Sanskrit: *Labhesha*, the ruler of the 11th house</note> in the sixth house brings various diseases. Yet, he shall possess all comforts, living abroad as a servant to others. || 6 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Eleventh House is situated in the sixth house <note>the house of debt, disease, and enemies</note>, the person is afflicted by various ailments. However, they obtain all kinds of pleasures, reside in foreign lands, and earn their living through service or employment. || 6 ||

---

### Results of the Lord of the Eleventh House in the Seventh and Eighth Houses

> The Lord of Gains in the seventh or eighth house grants a beautiful wife. He is generous, wealthy, sensual, and certainly a priest <note>Sanskrit: *Bhusura*, literally "a god on earth," referring to the Brahmin caste</note>. || 7 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Eleventh House is situated in the seventh or eighth house, the person's wife is beautiful. Furthermore, the individual himself is generous, wealthy, driven by desire, and is certainly a member of the priestly class. || 7 ||

---

### Results of the Lord of the Eleventh House in the Ninth and Tenth Houses

> The Lord of Gains in the sky <note>the 10th house</note> or the house of dharma <note>the 9th house</note> makes one a prince or a master of wealth. He is clever, truthful, and devoted to his own faith. || 8 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Eleventh House is situated in the ninth or tenth house, the person is like a king's son or a lord of riches; he is clever, truthful, and follows his own religious duties. || 8 ||

---

## Now, the Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House.

### First, the Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House in the Twelfth and Sixth Houses

> The Lord of Expenditure <note>Sanskrit: *Vyayesha*, the ruler of the 12th house</note> in the house of enemies <note>6th</note> or the house of loss <note>12th</note> makes one a sinner who contemplates the death of his mother. He is angry, suffers on account of his children, and is a libertine with the wives of others. || 1 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Twelfth House is situated in the sixth or twelfth house, the person is sinful, wishes for the death of his mother, is prone to anger, remains unhappy regarding his children, and enjoys the company of other men's wives. || 1 ||

---

### Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House in the First and Seventh Houses

> The Lord of Expenditure in the house of passion <note>7th</note> or the Ascendant <note>1st house</note> results in no happiness from a wife. He is weak, suffers from phlegmatic diseases <note>Sanskrit: *Kapha-rogi*, an imbalance of the water/earth humor</note>, yet is wealthy and skilled in sciences. || 2 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the Twelfth House is located in the Ascendant <term>Lagna: the sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth</term> or the seventh house, the person lacks marital happiness, is physically weak, suffers from phlegm-related illnesses, but is wealthy and an expert in various branches of knowledge. || 2 ||

---

### Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House in the Second and Eighth Houses

> The Lord of Expenditure in the house of wealth <note>2nd</note> or the house of death <note>8th</note> is endowed with devotion to Vishnu.

<header>Appendix</header>

-># Appendix<-

> <note>original: "धार्मिकः प्रियवादी च गुणैः सर्वैः समन्वितः ॥ ३ ॥"</note> He is righteous, speaks kindly, and is endowed with all good qualities. || 3 ||

If at the time of birth the <term>Lord of the 12th House</term><note>Sanskrit: Vyayesha; the planet ruling the house of loss and liberation</note> is situated in the second or eighth house, that person will be a devotee of Lord Vishnu, religious, soft-spoken, and possessed of all virtues. || 3 ||

->### Results of the Lord of the 12th House in the Third or Ninth House<-

> <note>original: "भ्रातृद्वेषी प्रियद्वेषी गुरुद्वेषी भवेन्नरः । व्ययेशे सहजे धर्मे स्वशरीरस्य पोषकः ॥ ४ ॥"</note> The man becomes a hater of brothers, a hater of loved ones, and a hater of teachers; when the Lord of the 12th is in the house of siblings or dharma, he cares only for the nourishment of his own body. || 4 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the 12th House is situated in the third or ninth house, that person will harbor enmity toward his brothers, his <term>Guru</term><note>teacher or spiritual preceptor</note>, and his friends, and will be primarily concerned with his own physical comforts. || 4 ||

->### Results of the Lord of the 12th House in the Tenth or Eleventh House<-

> <note>original: "व्ययेशे दशमे लाभे पुत्रसौख्य भवेन्नहि । मणिमाणिक्यमुक्ताभिर्धन किञ्चित्समाप्नुयात् ॥ ५ ॥"</note> When the Lord of the 12th is in the tenth or the house of gains, there is no happiness from sons; he may obtain some wealth through gems, rubies, and pearls. || 5 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the 12th House is situated in the tenth or eleventh house, that person will be deprived of the happiness of having a son, and will earn some wealth through the buying and selling of jewels, rubies, and pearls. || 5 ||

->### Results of the Lord of the 12th House in the Fourth or Fifth House<-

> <note>original: "व्ययेशे च सुते तुर्ये नीचबुद्धिर्भवेन्नरः । गृहभूमिसुखैर्हीनो जनन्याः क्लेशकारकः ॥ ६ ॥"</note> When the Lord of the 12th is in the house of children or the fourth, the man is of low intellect; he is devoid of the happiness of home and land, and causes distress to his mother. || 6 ||

If at the time of birth the Lord of the 12th House is situated in the fourth or fifth house, that person will possess a base intellect, will lack the comforts of a home and landed property, and will cause suffering to his mother. || 6 ||

->### Thus ends the results of the House Lords.<-

<meta>This page serves as the author's preface and autobiographical introduction. Achyutananda Jha establishes his scholarly authority by tracing his lineage back to the Vidarbha region and the Kashyapa clan, then listing sixteen major works he has authored or commented upon, primarily in the fields of astronomy, mathematics, and astrology.</meta>

# Introduction

In the land of Vidarbha <note>A historical region in central India, often associated with the kingdom of Berar</note>, where in ancient times Rama lived happily alongside the daughter of Janaka <note>Sita</note>; there is a city known as **"Jariso"**, famous and praised by wise men, located about two miles to the east of the city of Darbhanga. ॥ 1 ॥

In that charming town was born a man named **"Devana"** Jha, of the illustrious Kashyapa lineage <note>One of the most ancient and venerated clans (gotras) of Brahmins</note>. He was known throughout the earth for his pure deeds and was constantly honored by all people. ॥ 2 ॥

Among his sons, who were endowed with various skills, three were particularly capable. The eldest was named **"Bhava"**; his younger brother, a learned man, was named **"Ruda"**. ॥ 3 ॥

The youngest among them was a man named **"Jayadatta"**. He was peaceful, steadfast, exceptionally handsome, and possessed great fame. A noble Brahmin of pure intentions, his feet were worshipped by many, and he was an expert in all forms of charity. ॥ 4 ॥

His son, the most capable among his siblings, was a man of science, kind-hearted, simple, and generous. This was **"Alunatha"**, my great-grandfather, who was peerless in his learning, penance, humility, and fame upon this earth. ॥ 5 ॥

Then was born my grandfather, a man of pure and excellent qualities, whose fame was as bright as the moon and whose mind was devoted to the feet of Lord Shiva. Known by the name **"Goswami"**, he was a master of the predictive sciences <note>Phalita Shastra, or predictive astrology</note> and an embodiment of peace. ॥ 6 ॥

He had five sons, all skilled in working for the welfare of the world, discerning, and very peaceful. Among these five, who were all possessed of faultless virtues, the youngest was my father, named **"Baladeva"**. ॥ 7 ॥

Among the sons born to him, who are the ornaments of this noble family, I am the eldest, born after the great poem **"Raghuvamsha"** <note>A poetic allusion; he likely means he is the eldest son, or perhaps named after the lineage of Raghu</note>. I, Achyutananda Jha, who constantly serves the feet of the Goddess Kali, seek the grace of wise and holy men whose hearts are moistened by the nectar of love. ॥ 8 ॥

In the jewel of a book named **"Calculus"** <note>original: "Chalanakalana"</note>, I have composed a very precise commentary explaining all questions and answers. Following that, I wrote a clear commentary on the **"Chohudaya"**, and a beautiful one on the **"Vastu Ratnavali"** <note>A treatise on Vastu Shastra, the science of architecture</note>. ॥ 9 ॥

After that, for the great benefit of all mankind, I published the **"Paddhatis"** <note>Manuals for rituals or calculations</note>. Then, O best of wise men, I composed a beautiful double-commentary on the **"Sutras of Jaimini"** <note>Foundational texts of a specific system of Indian astrology</note>, which is this fifth book. ॥ 10 ॥

Next, the very beautiful chapter on the **"Fruits of the Houses"** <note>Bhava-phala-adhyaya</note> spoken by the sage Lomasa was purified by me with a commentary titled "Vimala" <note>The Pure One</note>. ॥ 11 ॥

In this seventh work, the **"Spherical Trigonometry"** <note>original: "Chapa-trikona-ganita"</note> composed by the leading mathematician Nilambara, I have provided a very elegant, clear, and lucid explanation that will be helpful to all good people. ॥ 12 ॥

In the eighth book, the famous **"Brihat Jataka"** <note>The Great Birth Chart, a foundational text of Indian horoscopy</note>, I authored the commentary named "Vimala," complete with rationales and examples, which is beloved by all. ॥ 13 ॥

In the ninth, the **"Algebra"** <note>original: "Bijaganita"</note>, I provided a commentary with instructional rationales. Then, in the tenth book, the **"Jataka Bharanam"**, I likewise composed the "Vimala" commentary. ॥ 14 ॥

I wrote a commentary on the **"Ramala Navaratna"** <note>A work on Ramala, a form of divination/geomancy</note> and the "Vimala" on the **"Chakra-desha"**. Then I composed a book of two or three hundred pages titled **"Simple Trigonometry"**. ॥ 15 ॥

I have also correctly presented **"Spherical Geometry"** <note>original: "Goli-rekhaganita"</note> in a book where the "Vimala" commentary is spoken. These books, numbering as many as the digits of the moon <note>sixteen</note>, have been printed and published by me for the delight of the learned. ॥ 16 ॥
